segments.normalizedSource: ```swift func swiftprintf(format: String, arguments: CVarArg...) -> String? { return withVaList(arguments) { va_list in var buffer: UnsafeMutablePointer<Int8>? = nil return format.withCString { cString in guard vasprintf(&buffer, cString, va_list) != 0 else { return nil } return String(validatingUTF8: buffer!) } } } print(swiftprintf(format: "√2 ≅ %g", arguments: sqrt(2.0))!) // Prints "√2 ≅ 1.41421" ```
